Name: Nora The Herpetologist - Custom NPC for East Scarp
Author: bagibagriela
Description:
[center]﻿﻿﻿﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/e1Rf02v.png[/img]﻿
Art by the amazing [url=https://twitter.com/Numi_Blu]Numinous_Blu[/url]!﻿﻿

﻿﻿Nora Chambers is a brilliant and enthusiastic herpetologist who lives with Victoria (Tori) in East Scarp.
She is a very friendly NPC with tons of dialogue and 14 events for you to get to know her![/center][center]﻿Nora is compatible with version 1.6 of Stardew Valley!

﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/wZ1ZJTS.png[/img][/center]
[quote]﻿[i]Nora comes to the valley to work on her PHD. She's trying to save an endangered species in the valley - the Purple Tailed Chameleon! In her journey to finish her thesis, she ends up discovering more about herself and what she wants for the future.

She will tell you fun facts about reptiles and amphibians and talk your ears off.

Nora is HOH (hard of hearing) and has dialogue and events about that. She has ADHD and she can PROVE it. She was born out of my passion for all the custom NPCs out there and wanting to become a creator myself.[/i][/quote]
[center]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/E19Sh7n.png[/img]

This is how you trigger all of Nora's heart events.﻿

[spoiler] 
[u]Nora's Main Heart Events

[/u][b]Introduction[/b]
Enter Nora's house between 8AM and 6PM. Only triggers if you haven't seen her 2 hearts event.

[b]1 Heart Event
[/b]Enter the Museum between 9AM and 6PM.

[b]2 Hearts Event
[/b]Enter Cindersap Forest on a sunny day between 9AM and 3PM. Only triggers in spring and summer. Can't be on a Wednesday or a Friday.

[b]3 Hearts Event
[/b]Enter the Museum between 10AM and 2PM on a Monday, Wednesday or Friday.

[b]4 Hearts Event
[/b]Enter the Museum between 10AM and 6PM. Doesn't trigger during Winter.

[b]6 Hearts Event
[/b]Enter Pelican Town between 7PM and 10PM. Doesn't trigger during Winter. Only triggers after seeing her 4 hearts event.

[b]8 Hearts (Part I)
[/b]Enter Nora's house between 4PM and 8PM. Only triggers after seeing her 6 hearts event.

[b]8 Hearts (Part II)
[/b]Enter the Saloon on a sunny day a week after seeing 8 hearts part I, between 12PM and 8PM.

[b]9 Hearts Event
[/b]Enter Cindersap Forest on a rainy day between 4PM and 10PM. Only triggers after seeing all parts of her 8 hearts event.

[b]10 Hearts Event Part I
[/b]Enter Pelican Town on a sunny day between 8AM and 4PM. Only triggers after seeing the 9 hearts event.

[b]10 Hearts Event Part II
[/b]Enter the Museum on a sunny day between 9AM and 6PM, 3 days after seeing 10 hearts part I. 

[b][u]Extra Events[/u][/b]

[b]Clinic
[/b]Enter Harvey's Clinic between 9AM and 3PM, during spring or summer.

[b]Ginger Island Part I
[/b]Visit Ginger Island after the Resort is built, on a sunny day, between 11AM and 5PM. Must have finished Nora's main storyline.
Doesn't trigger during winter.

[b]Ginger Island Part II
[/b]Enter Professor Snail's office 5 days after seeing Ginger Island Part I, on a sunny day, between 11AM and 5PM.

[b][u]Crossover Events

[/u]Creative Differences - Rodney O'Brien
[/b]Enter the Museum between 9AM and 6PM. Must have 2 hearts with both Nora and Rodney.

[b]Frog Friends
[/b]Enter Marnie's house between 9am AM and 3PM on any day except Monday and Tuesday. Must have 2 hearts with 

[/spoiler]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XxWaCDy.png[/img]﻿

In the 2.0.0 update, Nora can be romanced. She is [b]dateable[/b], NOT marriageable - you can date her, but she won't accept any marriage proposal.

In order to romance her, you must finish her storyline, including the events taking place in Ginger Island. After that, 
an event will trigger to allow you to date her. Details below.

[spoiler]

Nora will show up at the farm and invite you to meet her at the Stardrop Saloon.

To get the dating event, you must enter the Saloon between 7PM and 10PM after seeing the farm event. You will have the option to romance her or remain platonic. No friendship points are earned or lost regardless of your choice.

If you choose the date her, Nora will appear as your girlfriend and get new romantic dialogue.

[b][u]Extra Event
[/u][/b]A week after you start dating her, you can enter the Town between 6PM and 10PM for a date with Nora!

[/spoiler]

 [img]https://i.imgur.com/l8n3HfD.png[/img]﻿

Nora can be found mostly in [b]Cindersap Forest[/b], the [b]Museum[/b], the [b]Inn [/b]and
at her own house.

She visits the [b]Saloon [/b]on Fridays to join everyone. Her yearly doctor checkup is [b]Summer 5th[/b].
She eventually hangs out at the [b]Town's Bridge[/b] too!

The next session contain spoilers about certain events. If you can't find Nora anywhere else,
try this!

[spoiler]
After the 8 hearts event part I, Nora will stay at her house finishing her research. You will
only find her there, and she won't have much dialogue as she is quite busy. She
will return to her regular schedule after a week!

After the 10 hearts event part I, Nora will begin her [b]job hunt[/b]. She will be away for
3 days, but will return shortly! 

[/spoiler]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qvOtfSY.png[/img]

[/list]
[center]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/0nMk7QD.png[/img]
﻿[/center][list]
[*]Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿; Nora will attend the Community Day if you have it installed!
[*]Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿; Nora will atend Ridgeside Gathering and Ember of Resolutions if you have Ridgeside!
[*]Compatible with the Custom Festivals: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15261]Fireworks Festival[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4882]Nikolai's Marketpalooza[/url]﻿! 
[*]Nora have comments about most of the East Scarp characters, including the add-ons: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12369]Never Ending Adventure & Circle of Thorns[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13437]Creative Differences - NPC Rodney[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10770]Lurking in the Dark - NPC Sen[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9999]Always Raining in the Valley[/url]﻿!
[*]She is also compatible with other NPCs out of East Scarp such as: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10950]Jean and Jorts[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6398]Juliet and Jessie[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5599]Professor Jasper Thomas[/url]!﻿
[*]Acknowledges the events of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18548]Grandpa's Ghost[/url]﻿! 
[*]Attends the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20099]Pride in the Valley[/url]﻿ Festival!
[/list]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/l9K4gc5.png[/img]
﻿[/center]If you wish to translate her files to your own language, please don't hesitate to approach me and ask so I can add it to her folder, or upload it yourself! I am one of the moderators of the [url=https://discord.com/invite/8C3aNKsGDD]East Scarp Discord Server[/url], so feel free to DM me!
